name: Flinders Golf Club
signature: A historic coastal links course with views to match — visitors and social groups welcome, one of the Peninsula's great outdoor afternoons
editorNote:
Flinders Golf Club is one of the most distinctive golf courses in Victoria — a natural links layout designed by Dr Alister MacKenzie (the architect behind Augusta National and Cypress Point) set on rugged coastal land above Bass Strait. It is widely regarded as one of Australia's finest public-access courses.

Visitors and social groups are welcome, and the club actively courts both green fee players and corporate days. The setting does the heavy lifting: clifftop fairways, ocean views, native coastal vegetation, and the kind of exposure that makes calm days feel like a gift.

Book ahead for weekend tee times. Worth combining with a post-round lunch at Flinders Hotel or the Flinders General Store.
whyWeGo: A MacKenzie-designed coastal links with Bass Strait views — one of Victoria's finest courses and genuinely open to visitors.
ifOnlyOneThing: Book a tee time and arrive early enough to walk the first hole twice.
